inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL projection normalizes hyphen-delimited identifiers with TRIM(BOTH '-' FROM ...) after concatenating component values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a route-label audit. Fixed labels contain delimiter padding and are normalized with TRIM(BOTH '-' FROM ...); a second projection uses TRIM(LEADING '#' FROM ...) to verify directional trimming. The source tables, identifiers, and application values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Hyphen and hash padding are deliberate. TRIM(BOTH '-' FROM ...) removes repeated hyphens from both ends, while TRIM(LEADING '#' FROM ...) removes only the leading hash run and preserves the trailing run.
determinism_notes: Route IDs, fixed labels, trim characters, trim directions, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE route_labels (route_id INT PRIMARY KEY, route_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, route_tag VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT route_id, TRIM(BOTH '-' FROM route_code) AS normalized_code, TRIM(LEADING '#' FROM route_tag) AS leading_trimmed_tag FROM route_labels ORDER BY route_id
